items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.3 covers the diagnostic inspection where an insured event under 2.6 is established. Here, the sudden accidental damage peril is in force (portable electronics cover is on the schedule), and the physical impact damage is verified and consistent with the description (2.6.6). The battery health is at 79%, below the 80% threshold in 2.6.8, so the unit is not portable insured equipment for the purposes of 2.6 and is not covered. Therefore, the gateway in 2.6.7 is not passed and no indemnity is payable for the diagnostic.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The policy (2.6.8) states that a unit with battery health below 80% is not portable insured equipment and is not covered under the accidental damage peril, regardless of the cause or which part is damaged. The physical damage is genuine and would otherwise be covered, but the battery health finding excludes the unit from cover. No indemnity is payable for the repair (2.6.7).
